# Rafiq v0.5.20: your agent knows your files

## Knowledge bases, one per agent
- **Attach folders to an agent.** Models → the agent's card → **Knowledge** → **Add folder**. Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`) and text (`.txt`) files are read into an index on this computer, cut at headings, each passage with its file, heading and lines. **Refresh index** rereads what changed and drops what was deleted.
- **Answers with citations.** The agent searches its folders, answers only from the passages it found, and cites each fact. Rafiq checks every citation against what the search returned before the answer is accepted; the valid ones become numbered links, and when the files don't answer the question, the agent says so.
- **Open the passage.** A citation opens the file in a panel with the cited lines marked; **Open file** opens it in VS Code at that line (or in your default app).
- **Only that agent.** Another agent can't search the folder, and removing it from an agent takes effect on its next search; old citations stop opening too.
- **Arabic ↔ English.** An Arabic question finds an English passage: the agent searches with words in both languages, and optional search by meaning (Ollama on your computer, or one of your agents' providers) connects them by meaning. Off by default: then no file text leaves your computer while indexing.
- **Where text goes, said plainly.** The Knowledge section says what's sent where while indexing and while answering, and every answer says where its passages went.

Details: [RAG / Agent Knowledge Bases](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ#rag--agent-knowledge-bases).

## Also in this update (0.5.19 came to the Mac only)
- **Local models reply at once:** Rafiq reads the chat ahead, gives Ollama a window that fits the model and your memory, reaches it over IPv4, and starts it when it's closed.
- **Speed under every reply:** tokens per second and the time to the first word.
- **Replies in your language:** each message tells the model its language, so a Russian message gets a Russian reply even from a small model.
- **Tools that fit:** tools that don't fit a model's window are left out, heaviest first, and the chat says so.
- **Mac:** GitHub Copilot sign-in, the Rafiq account and phone, and changeable shortcuts with ⌘ ⌃ ⌥.

## Updating
Rafiq offers the update by itself. Or download `Rafiq_0.5.20_x64-setup.exe` below and check it:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.20_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the result with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

macOS (Apple Silicon): [Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/download/macos/Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg). The terminal on its own: the [cli](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/tag/cli) release.
